question: Which famous Indian dancer is associated with Pandavani dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Teejan Bai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandavani **is a traditional performing art form from Chhattisgarh, India.
 
• It involves the narration of the epic Mahabharata through songs and storytelling, accompanied by music and dance.
 
• Pandavani dance form is a style of Pandavani that incorporates dance movements into the storytelling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Vyjayanthimala is a famous Indian classical dancer and actress, known for her contributions to Bharatanatyam and Hindi cinema. However, she is not associated with Pandavani dance form.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is a renowned Kathak dancer and choreographer from India, known for his mastery of the Lucknow gharana style. He is not associated with Pandavani dance form.
 
• Vempati Chinna Satyam was a legendary Kuchipudi dancer and choreographer from Andhra Pradesh, India. He is not associated with Pandavani dance form.
